# Improvado MCP

> Improvado MCP is a remote Model Context Protocol server that lets AI agents work with marketing data in an Improvado workspace: ads, CRM and analytics sources that the account has connected. This repository contains public listing manifests and setup instructions. Improvado hosts the server; its implementation is not open source and is not in this repository.

Server URL: https://report.improvado.io/experimental/agent/api/mcp-customer/v1/invoke/ (streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in with an Improvado account)

MCP Registry name: io.improvado/mcp

## What it does

- Lists the marketing data sources available to the signed-in account.
- Answers questions about spend, performance and conversions across connected channels.
- Helps build summaries and comparisons, such as weekly performance reports or cross-channel ROAS.

Results depend on the sources connected to the workspace and on the account's permissions.

## Install

- ChatGPT: Apps > search "Improvado" > Improvado AI Agent > Connect.
- Claude Desktop: Customize > Connectors > Add custom connector > paste the server URL.
- Claude Code: claude plugin marketplace add tekliner/improvado-mcp, then claude plugin install improvado@improvado
- Cursor and VS Code: install buttons in README.md.
- Gemini CLI: gemini extensions install https://github.com/tekliner/improvado-mcp
